Wells Fargo Interview Experience 
Soumil Kamat | TY BTech IT 
 
Coding Round: 
It was conducted on AMCAT platform and the webcam had to be kept on, also no changing 
tabs/windows was permitted. 
Section 1: Reading comprehension and general vocabulary questions were asked and I could answer 
most of them. (Questions had to be attempted in the given order only) 
Section 2: There were questions based on stock market, choosing the best airline scheme, etc. I was able 
to answer half of the questions well and just guessed the remaining as the time was insufficient. 
(Questions had to be attempted in the given order only) 
Section 3: There were 2 coding questions to be solved in an hour. I had solved the second question first 
as I had found it easy but I don’t recollect the question. The first question was tricky to understand from 
the wording but it was based on finding the greatest difference in the position of any 2 elements which 
were incorrectly ordered (with respect to ascending order of themselves) in the array (i.e., greatest 
distance between the 2 elements of any inverted pair in the array). I managed to pass 11/13 test cases 
using brute force. 
Round 2: 
This was a technical round based on DSA, OOPS, OS conducted on Zoom. I was asked to give my 
introduction, then I was asked DSA questions such as which is the best sorting method according to me 
and why. Then I was asked to write the code for checking if an element is present given an unsorted 
array using binary search. I was able to code it but there was a small error in the sorting part which I was 
able to rectify later. Then I was to write the code for merging two linked lists. I attempted the question 
but due to some error the code didn’t work. Then I was asked about stack, 4 oops pillars and functions 
of operating systems which I could answer. I was also asked about deque but I didn’t know about that. I 
didn’t feel that the round went extremely well but I was shortlisted for the next round to my delight! 
Round 3: 
This was mostly a tech round also on Zoom. First, I was asked to introduce myself. Then I was asked a 
question on explaining a data structure with an example of how it is used in real life. I was also asked 
about which operating systems I have used. Then I was asked about my previous internship, academic 
projects and interests. Then I briefly explained about my recent projects and was asked questions on 
them such as SQL vs NoSQL, authentication, motivation behind making the project, etc. Then I was 
asked about which domains I would be most interested to work on and then if I had any questions. This 
round went well and I got selected along with 5 other students!                                                                    
There was an hr round the next day on phone and it was a mere formality.
